name: Woodbury Village
summary: Woodbury Village is an upscale lifestyle center featuring the best selection of independent high-end boutiques and restaurants on Long Island. This sophisticated destination offers discerning shoppers a curated mix of fine retail stores, premium services, and exceptional dining experiences in an intimate open-air setting.
demographics: Woodbury Village attracts affluent shoppers from one of the most densely populated and wealthy regional markets in America, primarily serving Long Island's high-income households. The center caters to sophisticated consumers seeking upscale boutique shopping and fine dining experiences, with visitors typically consisting of middle-aged to older adults with substantial disposable income. The trade area encompasses Nassau County's premium residential communities, drawing customers who value curated, independent retailers over mass-market chains and prefer a refined shopping atmosphere with personalized service.
description: Woodbury Village is an upscale lifestyle destination strategically positioned in the heart of Long Island's most affluent market at the northeast corner of Jericho Turnpike and South Woods Road in Woodbury, New York. This sophisticated shopping center distinguishes itself by offering a carefully curated collection of independent high-end boutiques, fine dining restaurants, and premium services that cater to discerning shoppers seeking alternatives to traditional mall experiences. The center's philosophy centers on providing a point-of-difference for the most sophisticated consumers, featuring unique retail concepts and culinary experiences not readily available elsewhere on Long Island. With its open-air design and emphasis on quality over quantity, Woodbury Village creates an intimate shopping environment where visitors can discover their next obsession among carefully selected merchants. The center encourages guests to make a day of their visit, inviting them to splurge on themselves and stay for dinner at one of the exceptional restaurants, making it a true lifestyle destination rather than just a shopping stop.
